name: storage
description: AWS S3 bucket for file/photo storage with presigned URL upload support and optional auth gating

docs.usage: Call POST /api/upload with { filename, contentType } to get a presigned PUT URL. PUT to S3 directly from browser. Store the returned key. Reference files as — never direct S3 URLs.
docs.auth: Set STORAGE_REQUIRE_AUTH=true to gate photo access behind auth (requires JWT_SECRET from auth service). Set to false for public access.
